fact: L'Interview reports that access to information in Togo is governed chiefly by Law no. 2016-006 of 30 March 2016 on freedom of access to public information and documentation, which sets reply deadlines, appeal procedures and sanctions for obstructing officials.
L'Interview reports that the decree setting the law's implementing arrangements (decree no. 2017-104/PR) was adopted by the Council of Ministers on 5 May 2017.
